description: Add or remove one person who can DM this AI employee, with the expected list revision and a reason. Summer reads only DMs from people on the list. Removing someone stops Summer reading and posting in that DM. Sends nothing.

allowed.description: true adds the person; false removes them.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

revision.description: Current list revision from teammates.slack.dms.list (0 for an empty list).

slack_user_id.description: The person's Slack member ID in the company's workspace, such as U012AB3CD.
